title: Sacramento Home Energy Rebates 2026: What SMUD Pays | HomePowerRebate
desc: Every home rebate from SMUD in 2026: heat pumps up to $3,000, water heaters up to $4,000, panel work up to $4,000, batteries, EV chargers and induction, with real install costs.
badge: Up to $4,000 for a water heater or panel work
lead: Sacramento is served by SMUD, the community-owned Sacramento Municipal Utility District, which runs one of the larger home rebate programs in California. Most of its money goes through contractors in the SMUD Contractor Network, and it publishes what customers actually paid. We read SMUD's pages on October 2, 2026.
cards_intro: Each card links to a page with the rules, the real prices and the local detail. SMUD's rebates depend on available funding, and the big ones must be submitted by a participating contractor.

cards.title: Heat pump
cards.note: $3,000 variable-stage and $2,000 two-stage when replacing gas; $1,000 for an electric upgrade.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: By tank size when replacing gas; $1,000 when replacing electric.

cards.title: Seal and insulate
cards.note: Through a Home Performance Program contractor.

cards.title: Panel and circuit work
cards.note: Go Electric rebates, with a gas-to-electric conversion.

cards.title: Home battery
cards.note: Up to $6,000. Cut from $500 per kWh on September 23, 2026.

cards.title: Smart thermostat
cards.note: Instant rebate online at the SMUD Energy Store.

sections: SMUD's heat pump, water heater and insulation rebates are paid only when a participating contractor in the SMUD Contractor Network does the work and submits the application for you. A great price from a company outside the network earns nothing from SMUD. Some contractors take the rebate off the bill up front and collect it from SMUD later, so ask. SMUD's Home Performance Program bundles the packages so one contractor can plan heating and cooling, water heating, insulation and electrical work together. Customers can call Advanced Home Solutions at 916-732-5732 or the rebate center at 916-732-7550.

SMUD publishes median installed prices from its own customers over the past 12 months, before rebates. A heat pump HVAC job, gas to electric, had a median of $18,804. A heat pump water heater, gas to electric, had a median of $6,220. Those numbers put the rebates in proportion: $3,000 on the heat pump and $3,000 to $4,000 on the water heater. SMUD recommends at least three bids and checking what each includes.

We found no SMUD cash rebate for solar panels. A figure of about $2,000 quoted on other sites does not appear on SMUD's pages, so we do not use it. SMUD's battery incentive is where its solar-related money goes, and it was cut on September 23, 2026. SMUD's pages also list no windows or ventilation rebates. If you find a current program we missed, tell us at hello@homepowerrebate.com.

SMUD's rebates page points out that the City of Sacramento's Department of Utilities offers up to $125 for replacing an old washing machine with a high-efficiency one, which can add to SMUD's $100 washer discount. Sacramento's average January low over 2015 to 2024 was 4.7°C, with a coldest recorded day of -3.0°C and about 5.1 peak sun hours a day, so heat pumps and solar both do well here.
The same SMUD amounts apply in Rancho Cordova and Folsom, with local permit differences covered on their pages. Roseville has its own utility and is different (Roseville).
Money that ended or is full

The federal 25C and 25D tax credits ended after December 31, 2025. Single-family TECH Clean California and federal HEEHRA help is fully reserved and takes requests on hold only. SMUD says its heat pump and water heater rebates can be stacked with statewide and federal incentives that are available, and points to the Switch Is On incentive lookup.
installers_intro: These Sacramento heat pump and HVAC companies have the best Google ratings, listed by rating and then review count. We are not paid to list anyone. SMUD pays only through its Contractor Network, so ask each company whether it is a member.
claim_steps: Look at your electric bill and confirm that SMUD supplies your power.
Open the page for the upgrade you plan and read the rules and prices.
Get at least three bids from contractors in the SMUD Contractor Network.
Ask each to put the rebate category and amount in writing.
Let the contractor submit the rebate, and track it through the contractor and then through SMUD's email.
faq: SMUD, the Sacramento Municipal Utility District, serves Sacramento and most of its county. Check the name on your electric bill.
Which SMUD rebate pays the most?
The heat pump water heater at up to $4,000 and Go Electric panel and circuit work at up to $4,000. A battery can earn up to $6,000 under the new cap.
Does SMUD pay a cash rebate for solar panels?
We found none. SMUD's battery enrollment incentive is its main solar-related offer.
Do I need a SMUD contractor?
For heat pumps, water heaters and insulation, yes. A participating contractor in the SMUD Contractor Network submits the rebate.
Can I stack SMUD with state and federal programs?
SMUD says its heat pump and water heater rebates can be stacked with available statewide and federal incentives. Single-family state programs are currently full, though.
